title: ASML 微影機系統工程~ASML Lithography Systems Engineering
focus: High-NA 變形光學、高加速度光罩台、EUV 護膜與集光鏡壽命、焦面對準量測、晶圓熱控、逐場套刻與產能可用度~High-NA anamorphic optics, high-acceleration reticle stages, pellicle and collector life, focus and alignment sensing, wafer thermal control, per-field overlay and productivity
summary: 延伸既有的解析度、光源鏈、多層膜與定位迴路課程，深入 0.55 NA 變形光學為何只能曝半場、8× 掃描倍率下 32 g 光罩台的動力學、EUV 護膜與集光鏡的壽命物理、水平與對準感測器的量測誤差、晶圓加熱與夾持、逐曝光套刻建模，以及每小時晶圓數與可用度的系統驗收。~Extending the existing lessons on resolution, the source chain, multilayers and positioning loops, this part goes into why 0.55 NA anamorphic optics expose only a half field, the dynamics of a 32 g reticle stage under 8× scan magnification, the lifetime physics of EUV pellicles and collectors, measurement errors of level and alignment sensors, wafer heating and clamping, per-exposure overlay modelling, and system acceptance of wafers per hour and availability.

units.anchor: 0.55 NA 變形投影光學~0.55 NA anamorphic projection optics
units.title: High-NA 變形光學與半場曝光~High-NA anamorphic optics and the half field
units.mechanism: 把 NA 從 0.33 提高到 0.55，光罩端的光錐也跟著變寬。EUV 光罩是反射式，入射錐與反射錐不能重疊，而且必須落在光罩多層膜的角度接受範圍內；以光罩上約 6° 的主光線角計算，若仍用等向 4× 縮小，光錐半角會超過 6°，入射與反射光互相干涉。ASML 的 EXE 平台因此採用變形光學：垂直掃描方向（x，沿狹縫）縮小 4×，掃描方向（y）縮小 8×，掃描方向的光罩端光錐減半。代價是標準 6 吋光罩的 104 × 132 mm 圖案區在晶圓上只剩 26 × 16.5 mm，即半場，每片晶圓曝光次數加倍，大晶粒需要拼接，光罩資料也必須在 y 方向拉長 2 倍。~Raising NA from 0.33 to 0.55 widens the cone of light at the reticle as well. The EUV reticle is reflective, so the incident and reflected cones must not overlap and must stay within the angular acceptance of the mask multilayer; with a chief-ray angle of about 6° on the mask, keeping an isotropic 4× reduction would push the cone half-angle beyond 6° and the incident and reflected light would collide. ASML's EXE platform therefore uses anamorphic optics: 4× reduction across the scan (x, along the slit) and 8× in the scan direction (y), halving the mask-side cone in y. The price is that the 104 × 132 mm pattern area of a standard 6-inch mask covers only 26 × 16.5 mm on the wafer, a half field, so each wafer needs twice as many exposures, large dies must be stitched, and mask data are stretched 2× in y.
units.model: 光罩端 NA = NA/M：NXE 為 0.33/4 = 0.0825（4.7°），光錐在 1.3° 到 10.7° 之間；0.55/4 = 0.1375（7.9°）超過 6° 主光線角，光錐跨越法線（−1.9° 到 13.9°）；y 方向 8× 時 0.0688（3.9°），光錐回到 2.1° 到 9.9°。場大小：x = 104/4 = 26 mm、y = 132/8 = 16.5 mm，面積 429 mm² 對 858 mm²；300 mm 晶圓含部分場約由 96 場增為約 186 場。k₁ = 0.33 時 CD = 0.33 × 13.5/0.55 ≈ 8.1 nm，而 λ/NA² 景深由 124 nm 降到 44.6 nm。~Mask-side NA = NA/M: NXE has 0.33/4 = 0.0825 (4.7°), a cone from 1.3° to 10.7°; 0.55/4 = 0.1375 (7.9°) exceeds the 6° chief-ray angle and the cone crosses the normal (−1.9° to 13.9°); with 8× in y it is 0.0688 (3.9°), back to 2.1° to 9.9°. Field size: x = 104/4 = 26 mm and y = 132/8 = 16.5 mm, 429 mm² against 858 mm²; a 300 mm wafer goes from about 96 to about 186 fields including partials. With k₁ = 0.33, CD = 0.33 × 13.5/0.55 ≈ 8.1 nm, while the λ/NA² depth of focus falls from 124 nm to 44.6 nm.
units.verify: 以含 x 與 y 兩種方向線距的測試光罩曝光，確認晶圓上兩方向的 CD 與圖案位置一致，儘管光罩上的尺寸相差 2 倍；量測場尺寸與兩個半場交界處的拼接套刻；做焦距—劑量矩陣，比較實測景深與 44.6 nm 等級的預測；再量不同節距與方向的最佳焦距差，評估光罩三維陰影效應。~Expose a test reticle with line-space patterns in both x and y and confirm that wafer CD and placement match in both orientations even though the mask features differ by 2×; measure field dimensions and the stitching overlay where two half fields meet; run a focus–exposure matrix and compare the measured depth of focus with the 44.6 nm-scale prediction; then measure best-focus differences across pitch and orientation to assess mask 3D shadowing.
units.failure: 超過 26 × 16.5 mm 的晶粒必須拆成兩個半場，交界處的套刻與 CD 不連續會讓跨越邊界的導線斷開或變細；若光罩資料的 y 方向縮放處理錯誤，整片圖案失真；光罩三維陰影造成與方向有關的影像位移，表現為無法用單一焦距修正的系統套刻。~A die larger than 26 × 16.5 mm must be split into two half fields, and overlay or CD discontinuity at the seam can open or neck lines that cross it; mishandled y scaling in the mask data distorts the whole pattern; mask 3D shadowing shifts images depending on orientation, showing up as systematic overlay that no single focus setting can correct.
units.misconception: High-NA 只是換上更大的反射鏡，曝光場大小與 NXE 相同。~High-NA simply uses bigger mirrors and keeps the same exposure field as NXE.

units.anchor: 光罩台與晶圓台同步~Reticle-stage and wafer-stage synchronisation
units.title: 8× 掃描倍率下的光罩台動力學~Reticle-stage dynamics under 8× scan magnification
units.mechanism: 掃描曝光時光罩與晶圓反向運動，速度比等於掃描方向的縮小倍率：NXE 為 4，EXE 為 8。同樣的晶圓掃描速度下，EXE 的光罩台要跑 NXE 的兩倍快，而且曝光場數加倍，加減速時間必須更短；ASML 公開的數字是 EXE 光罩台 32 g（NXE 的四倍）、晶圓台 8 g。8× 倍率也有好處：光罩在掃描方向的位置誤差到晶圓上縮小 8 倍，垂直方向縮小 4 倍。代價是慣性力：真空中的光罩靠靜電夾盤的摩擦力固定，加速度越大越容易微滑，而光罩滑移會直接變成影像位移。同步誤差的移動平均（MA）與移動標準差（MSD）以晶圓座標、在狹縫曝光窗內計算。~During a scan the reticle and wafer move in opposite directions with a speed ratio equal to the scan-direction reduction: 4 for NXE and 8 for EXE. For the same wafer scan speed the EXE reticle stage must run twice as fast as NXE's, and with twice as many fields the ramps must be shorter; ASML publishes 32 g for the EXE reticle stage, four times NXE, and 8 g for the wafer stage. The 8× ratio also helps: reticle position errors in the scan direction shrink 8× at the wafer and cross-scan errors 4×. The price is inertial force: in vacuum the reticle is held by friction on an electrostatic clamp, higher acceleration invites micro-slip, and any reticle slip becomes image displacement. Moving-average (MA) and moving-standard-deviation (MSD) synchronisation errors are computed in wafer coordinates over the slit exposure window.
units.model: 晶圓 0.4 m/s 時光罩 3.2 m/s；以 32 g（313.8 m/s²）加速需 10.2 ms、16.3 mm，同步加速段晶圓只需 32/8 = 4 g；若光罩台只有 8 g，則需 40.8 ms。光罩 152 × 152 × 6.35 mm、密度 2210 kg/m³，質量 0.324 kg，慣性力 0.324 × 313.8 ≈ 102 N；摩擦係數 0.25 時夾持正向力至少 407 N，安全係數 2 取 814 N；靜電壓力 ½ε₀E² 在 E ≈ 10⁸ V/m 時約 44 kPa，以 40 kPa 計需約 0.020 m² 夾持面積。光罩端 4 nm 的 MA 在晶圓掃描方向只剩 0.5 nm。~At a wafer speed of 0.4 m/s the reticle runs 3.2 m/s; at 32 g (313.8 m/s²) the ramp takes 10.2 ms and 16.3 mm, during which the wafer needs only 32/8 = 4 g, whereas an 8 g reticle stage would need 40.8 ms. A 152 × 152 × 6.35 mm mask at 2210 kg/m³ weighs 0.324 kg, so the inertial force is 0.324 × 313.8 ≈ 102 N; with friction coefficient 0.25 the clamp normal force must be at least 407 N, 814 N with a safety factor of 2; electrostatic pressure ½ε₀E² is about 44 kPa at E ≈ 10⁸ V/m, so at 40 kPa about 0.020 m² of clamp area is needed. A 4 nm reticle MA becomes only 0.5 nm at the wafer in the scan direction.
units.verify: 以載台編碼器在不同掃描速度與加速度下記錄同步誤差，計算 MA 與 MSD 並與預算比較；在大量加減速循環前後，以光罩對準感測器重複量測光罩基準標記位置，確認累積滑移低於允收值；同時記錄馬達電流與光罩台溫度，因為馬達發熱與力的平方成正比。~Record synchronisation error from stage encoders at several scan speeds and accelerations, compute MA and MSD and compare with the budget; measure reticle fiducial positions with the reticle alignment sensors before and after many acceleration cycles to confirm that accumulated slip stays below allowance; log motor current and reticle-stage temperature at the same time, because motor heating scales with the square of force.
units.failure: 光罩每數千次掃描微滑零點幾奈米，累積成場內套刻漂移，晶圓間的對準無法完全抓到；夾盤凸點上的顆粒降低接觸面積與摩擦力，同時造成局部變形；32 g 下馬達發熱提高光罩台溫度，使量測框架漂移。~A reticle that slips a fraction of a nanometre every few thousand scans accumulates intra-field overlay drift that wafer-to-wafer alignment cannot fully capture; particles on clamp burls reduce contact area and friction while locally deforming the mask; motor heating at 32 g warms the reticle stage and drifts the metrology frame.
units.misconception: 光罩誤差到晶圓會縮小 8 倍，所以光罩台的動態要求可以放寬。~Reticle errors shrink 8× at the wafer, so reticle-stage dynamics can be relaxed.

units.anchor: EUV 護膜與光罩正面~EUV pellicle and reticle front side
units.title: EUV 護膜穿透率、熱負載與光罩缺陷~EUV pellicle transmission, heat load and reticle defectivity
units.mechanism: 護膜是一張只有數十奈米厚的自撐薄膜，裝在光罩前方數毫米處；落在護膜上的顆粒嚴重離焦而不成像，但若直接落在光罩上，會在每個場的每顆晶粒重複印出。EUV 下薄膜本身會吸收，而且光線來回穿過兩次，所以單程穿透率 T 對產能的影響是 T²；吸收的功率在真空中只能靠輻射散熱，光源功率越高薄膜溫度可達數百 °C。ASML 公開的第一代護膜約 50 nm 厚、單程損失約 10%，後續的矽化物、碳奈米管等材料在穿透率、強度與熱穩定性之間取捨。數微米以上的顆粒仍不能留在護膜上，抽真空與破真空時的壓差也是薄膜破裂的風險。~A pellicle is a free-standing membrane only tens of nanometres thick mounted a few millimetres in front of the reticle; particles landing on it are far out of focus and do not print, whereas a particle on the mask itself repeats in every die of every field. In EUV the membrane absorbs and the light crosses it twice, so a single-pass transmission T costs throughput as T²; the absorbed power can leave only by radiation in vacuum, and at higher source powers the film reaches several hundred °C. ASML's published first-generation pellicle was about 50 nm thick with roughly 10% single-pass loss, and later silicide and carbon-nanotube materials trade transmission, strength and thermal stability. Particles larger than a few micrometres must still be kept off the film, and pressure differences during pump-down and venting are a rupture risk.
units.model: T = 0.90 時雙程 0.81，曝光受限下產能損失 19%。熱負載：20 W EUV 照在 104 × 8 mm 狹縫區（8.32 cm²），第一程吸收 2.0 W，經光罩 0.65 反射後第二程吸收 1.17 W，共 3.17 W、3.8 kW/m²；雙面輻射 q = 2εσT⁴，ε = 0.3 時 T ≈ 578 K（305 °C），功率加倍升到約 415 °C。顆粒陰影：間距 2.5 mm、光罩端 NA 0.0825，模糊直徑 2h·NA ≈ 0.41 mm，10 µm 顆粒只遮掉 (10/412)² ≈ 6×10⁻⁴。~With T = 0.90 the double pass is 0.81, a 19% throughput loss when exposure-limited. Heat load: 20 W of EUV on a 104 × 8 mm slit area (8.32 cm²) deposits 2.0 W on the first pass and, after 0.65 mask reflectance, 1.17 W on the second, 3.17 W or 3.8 kW/m²; two-sided radiation q = 2εσT⁴ with ε = 0.3 gives T ≈ 578 K (305 °C), about 415 °C if power doubles. Particle shadow: at 2.5 mm standoff and mask-side NA 0.0825 the blur is 2h·NA ≈ 0.41 mm, so a 10 µm particle blocks only (10/412)² ≈ 6×10⁻⁴.
units.verify: 安裝前以 13.5 nm 反射／穿透量測確認單程穿透率與均勻性；上機後比較有無護膜時晶圓端的劑量感測器讀值，並以紅外熱像追蹤曝光中的薄膜溫度；定期以散射式檢測檢查護膜顆粒，並在固定晶圓數後檢查光罩正面新增顆粒；最後以晶粒對晶粒比對找出重複性缺陷。~Before mounting confirm single-pass transmission and uniformity by 13.5 nm reflectometry and transmission measurement; on the tool compare wafer-level dose-sensor readings with and without the pellicle and track film temperature during exposure by infrared imaging; inspect the pellicle for particles with scatter-based inspection and check the reticle front side for adders after fixed wafer counts; finally search for repeating defects by die-to-die comparison.
units.failure: 高功率或抽氣壓差使薄膜破裂，碎片污染光罩與機台內部；長期加熱使薄膜起皺或氧化，穿透率緩慢下降，造成劑量漂移；沒有護膜時，一顆 100 nm 顆粒落在光罩上就會在每顆晶粒印出重複缺陷，直到被檢出前整批產品良率受損。~High power or a pump-down pressure difference ruptures the film and its fragments contaminate the reticle and tool interior; prolonged heating wrinkles or oxidises the film so transmission slowly falls and dose drifts; without a pellicle a single 100 nm particle on the mask prints a repeating defect in every die, damaging the yield of whole lots until it is caught.
units.misconception: 護膜只是透明保護層，對產能沒有影響。~A pellicle is just a transparent cover with no effect on throughput.

units.anchor: 集光鏡與氫氣緩衝~Collector mirror and hydrogen buffer
units.title: 集光鏡壽命：錫沉積與氫自由基清潔~Collector lifetime: tin deposition and hydrogen-radical cleaning
units.mechanism: 集光鏡是一面大型橢球 Mo/Si 多層膜反射鏡，距錫電漿僅數百毫米，把電漿成像到中間焦點。每一發脈衝都噴出錫離子、中性原子與微小碎屑；約百帕的氫氣緩衝層讓離子減速，EUV 光子與電漿則產生氫自由基，把沉積的錫蝕刻成可揮發的 SnH₄，由氣流帶到真空泵。集光鏡反射率由沉積與蝕刻的平衡決定：SnH₄ 若在熱表面分解會把錫再沉積回去，氫滲入多層膜則可能起泡。壽命以每十億發（gigapulse）的相對反射率損失追蹤，光源以提高驅動雷射功率或掃描機延長曝光來維持劑量，最後排定更換。~The collector is a large ellipsoidal Mo/Si multilayer mirror only a few hundred millimetres from the tin plasma, imaging the plasma onto the intermediate focus. Every pulse throws out tin ions, neutral atoms and fine debris; a hydrogen buffer of order a hundred pascals slows the ions, while EUV photons and the plasma create hydrogen radicals that etch deposited tin into volatile SnH₄, which the gas flow carries to the pumps. Collector reflectance is set by the balance of deposition and etching: SnH₄ that decomposes on hot surfaces puts tin back, and hydrogen penetrating the multilayer can raise blisters. Lifetime is tracked as relative reflectance loss per gigapulse, the source holds dose by raising drive-laser power or the scanner by lengthening exposure, and a replacement is eventually scheduled.
units.model: 50 kHz 時 1 Gpulse = 20 000 s ≈ 5.6 h，每天 4.32 Gpulse。教學假設衰減 0.04%/Gpulse，每天 0.17%；允許損失 15% 時可用 375 Gpulse，約 87 天。曝光受限時每小時晶圓數與反射率成正比，損失 15% 而不補償就少 15% 產能；若要維持產能，中間焦點功率需提高到 1/0.85 ≈ 1.18 倍。~At 50 kHz one gigapulse is 20 000 s ≈ 5.6 h, or 4.32 Gpulse per day. With an assumed loss of 0.04% per Gpulse, reflectance falls 0.17% per day; a 15% allowance lasts 375 Gpulse, about 87 days. When exposure-limited, wafers per hour scale with reflectance, so an uncompensated 15% loss costs 15% throughput, and keeping throughput requires intermediate-focus power raised to 1/0.85 ≈ 1.18 times.
units.verify: 以光源內的能量感測器量中間焦點功率，除以驅動雷射能量得到轉換效率乘集光鏡反射率的趨勢，並與掃描機劑量感測器交叉比對；以中間焦點遠場影像看反射率的空間分佈，找出不均勻沉積；以殘氣分析追蹤 SnH₄ 與水氣分壓；把每 Gpulse 的衰減斜率記錄成維修預測的依據。~Measure intermediate-focus power with in-source energy sensors and divide by drive-laser energy to trend conversion efficiency times collector reflectance, cross-checking with the scanner dose sensor; use far-field images of the intermediate focus to map reflectance spatially and reveal uneven deposition; follow SnH₄ and water partial pressures by residual-gas analysis; log the per-gigapulse decay slope as the basis for maintenance forecasting.
units.failure: 錫在集光鏡周邊再沉積，使光瞳填充不均，照明均勻度與成像隨之改變；覆蓋層因氫起泡造成不可逆的反射率損失；若只看劑量是否合格而不追蹤衰減斜率，某天會突然需要更換集光鏡，造成數天停機。~Tin redeposited around the collector periphery fills the pupil unevenly, changing illumination uniformity and imaging; hydrogen blistering of the cap causes irreversible reflectance loss; watching only whether dose passes, without trending the decay slope, leads to a sudden collector swap and days of downtime.
units.misconception: 集光鏡反射率慢慢下降只影響光源亮度，不影響每小時晶圓數。~A slowly falling collector reflectance only dims the source and does not affect wafers per hour.

units.anchor: 水平感測器與對準感測器~Level sensor and alignment sensor
units.title: 焦面與對準標記的量測物理~Measurement physics of focus and alignment sensors
units.mechanism: 雙載台掃描機在量測側先量晶圓：水平感測器以掠射角把光柵圖樣投到晶圓上，反射像的橫移正比於高度，逐場繪出地形與晶圓不平度，曝光時載台沿此焦面追蹤。因為光從多層透明膜反射，量到的「表觀高度」與膜層結構有關，這種製程相依偏差要用氣壓式量規或選擇波長、偏振來校正。對準感測器量繞射光柵標記的位置：±1 階干涉的相位就是位置；化學機械研磨或蝕刻使標記不對稱時，誤差隨波長改變，因此用多波長量測並比較色間差異來偵測不對稱。0.55 NA 的景深只剩約 45 nm，焦距預算縮到數奈米。~On the measure side of a dual-stage scanner the wafer is mapped first: the level sensor projects a grating pattern onto the wafer at grazing incidence, and the lateral shift of the reflected image is proportional to height, so each field's topography and wafer unflatness are mapped for the stage to follow during exposure. Because the light reflects from a stack of transparent films, the apparent height depends on the stack, and this process dependency is calibrated with an air gauge or by choice of wavelength and polarisation. The alignment sensor locates diffraction-grating marks, where the phase of the ±1-order interference is the position; marks made asymmetric by CMP or etch give wavelength-dependent errors, so multi-wavelength readings and colour-to-colour differences expose asymmetry. At 0.55 NA the depth of focus is only about 45 nm and the focus budget shrinks to a few nanometres.
units.model: 三角量測：入射角 θ 時反射光橫移 Δ = 2h·sinθ，θ = 80° 得 Δ ≈ 1.97h，1 nm 高度只移 1.97 nm，須靠大面積光柵平均才能解析次奈米。景深 λ/NA²：0.33 NA 為 124 nm、0.55 NA 為 44.6 nm。對準：±1 階干涉 x = P·φ/(4π)，P = 1.6 µm 時 10 mrad 相位雜訊為 1.27 nm；標記不對稱額外造成 0.02 rad 相位，位置誤差 2.5 nm，與整個產品套刻預算同級。~Triangulation: at incidence θ the reflected beam shifts Δ = 2h·sinθ, so θ = 80° gives Δ ≈ 1.97h and 1 nm of height moves the beam only 1.97 nm, resolvable at sub-nanometre level only by averaging over a large grating. Depth of focus λ/NA² is 124 nm at 0.33 NA and 44.6 nm at 0.55 NA. Alignment: ±1-order interference gives x = P·φ/(4π), so with P = 1.6 µm a 10 mrad phase noise is 1.27 nm; mark asymmetry adding 0.02 rad of phase gives a 2.5 nm position error, the same size as the whole on-product overlay budget.
units.verify: 在不同膜層的產品晶圓上比較水平感測器與氣壓式量規讀值，建立每種膜層的製程修正；以焦距敏感標記或焦距—劑量矩陣量出實際最佳焦距圖，與水平感測器圖比較；對準方面，用多個波長量同一組標記，色間偏差超過門檻即標記為不對稱，再把預測套刻與曝光後套刻量測比對。~Compare level-sensor and air-gauge readings on product wafers with different stacks to build a process correction per stack; measure the true best-focus map with focus-sensitive targets or a focus–exposure matrix and compare with the level-sensor map; for alignment read the same marks at several wavelengths, flag marks whose colour-to-colour deviation exceeds a threshold as asymmetric, and compare predicted overlay with post-exposure overlay metrology.
units.failure: 新膜層的製程相依偏差未校正，晶圓邊緣或特定區域焦距偏數十奈米，造成 CD 變異與缺陷；對準到不對稱的標記，整片晶圓帶有數奈米的系統偏移，看起來卻像隨機套刻雜訊。~An uncalibrated process dependency on a new stack shifts focus by tens of nanometres at the wafer edge or in particular regions, causing CD variation and defects; aligning to asymmetric marks gives the whole wafer a systematic offset of a few nanometres that looks like random overlay noise.
units.misconception: 水平感測器量到的就是光阻表面真實高度，與下層膜無關。~The level sensor reads the true resist height regardless of the underlying film stack.

units.anchor: 晶圓夾盤、凸點與溫控~Wafer clamp, burls and thermal conditioning
units.title: 晶圓加熱、夾持與晶圓台熱控~Wafer heating, clamping and wafer-table thermal control
units.mechanism: EUV 晶圓在真空中由靜電夾盤固定，夾盤表面是數千個微小凸點，以減少接觸面積、降低顆粒造成的局部變形，熱量經由凸點與背面氣體傳到台面。每次曝光把劑量能量與吸收的帶外紅外線留在該場，局部升溫使晶圓想要膨脹；凸點的摩擦力先抵抗，當剪力超過摩擦力時晶圓局部滑移，形成與曝光順序有關的場間變形。晶圓上機前的溫度必須與台面差在毫開爾文等級，台面以水循環控溫，並以前饋的晶圓加熱模型預測每場膨脹、調整倍率與平移。~An EUV wafer is held in vacuum by an electrostatic clamp whose surface consists of thousands of small burls, reducing contact area and particle-induced deformation, and heat leaves through the burls and backside gas into the table. Each exposure leaves its dose energy plus absorbed out-of-band infrared in that field, and the local temperature rise makes the wafer want to expand; burl friction resists at first, but once shear exceeds friction the wafer slips locally, producing field-to-field distortion that depends on exposure order. The wafer must arrive within millikelvins of the table temperature, the table is water-conditioned, and a feedforward wafer-heating model predicts expansion per field to adjust magnification and translation.
units.model: 50 mJ/cm² 乘半場 26 × 16.5 mm 得每場 0.2145 J；若絕熱地留在場下方 775 µm 厚的矽（2330 kg/m³、c = 700 J/kg·K，質量 0.775 g），ΔT ≈ 0.40 K；自由膨脹在 26 mm 上為 26 mm × 2.6 ppm/K × 0.40 K ≈ 27 nm，是套刻預算的十倍，凸點夾持與熱傳導必須壓掉九成以上。晶圓上機溫差 10 mK 時，半徑 150 mm 處膨脹 150 mm × 2.6 ppm/K × 0.01 K = 3.9 nm。~50 mJ/cm² over a 26 × 16.5 mm half field is 0.2145 J per field; held adiabatically in the 775 µm of silicon under the field (2330 kg/m³, c = 700 J/kg·K, mass 0.775 g) it gives ΔT ≈ 0.40 K, and free expansion across 26 mm is 26 mm × 2.6 ppm/K × 0.40 K ≈ 27 nm, ten times the overlay budget, so burl clamping and conduction must suppress more than 90%. A 10 mK loading offset expands the wafer at 150 mm radius by 150 mm × 2.6 ppm/K × 0.01 K = 3.9 nm.
units.verify: 以高劑量與低劑量曝光同一佈局，量出與曝光順序相關的套刻圖，與晶圓加熱模型的預測比較；以台面溫度感測器追蹤每片晶圓的升溫曲線；夾持前後各量一次晶圓形狀與對準標記，分離夾持變形；定期量夾盤平坦度圖，檢查凸點磨耗或污染。~Expose the same layout at high and low dose, measure the overlay pattern correlated with exposure order and compare it with the wafer-heating model; follow each wafer's temperature rise with table sensors; measure wafer shape and alignment marks before and after clamping to separate clamp-induced distortion; map clamp flatness periodically to check for burl wear or contamination.
units.failure: 凸點磨耗或沾上顆粒，局部高度突起造成焦距熱點，摩擦力也改變，使晶圓加熱模型失效，晶圓邊緣套刻變差；高翹曲晶圓（例如多層堆疊記憶體）無法完全吸平，夾持本身就引入數奈米變形。~Worn or particle-contaminated burls create local height bumps that become focus hot spots and change friction so the wafer-heating model no longer holds and edge overlay degrades; highly warped wafers such as deep-stack memory cannot be fully flattened, so clamping itself introduces nanometres of distortion.
units.misconception: 晶圓被靜電夾緊後就不會熱膨脹。~Once electrostatically clamped, a wafer cannot expand thermally.

units.anchor: 套刻量測與逐場修正~Overlay metrology and per-exposure corrections
units.title: 場間套刻建模與逐曝光修正~Field-to-field overlay modelling and corrections per exposure
units.mechanism: 套刻誤差可拆成：晶圓層級（場間）的平移、旋轉、倍率與非正交（六參數線性模型）及高階多項式；場內的倍率、旋轉與非對稱項（十參數模型）以及鏡頭與光罩特徵；還有無法修正的隨機殘差。以繞射式套刻標記量測後，先進製程控制把修正量回饋給掃描機致動器：載台負責平移與旋轉，鏡頭與光罩台負責倍率；逐曝光修正（CPE）讓每一場都有自己的一組小修正。參數越多能吃掉越多系統特徵，但也會把量測雜訊擬合進去，參數數與取樣點數共同決定雜訊放大。~Overlay error splits into wafer-level (inter-field) translation, rotation, magnification and non-orthogonality, the six-parameter linear model, plus higher-order polynomials; intra-field magnification, rotation and asymmetric terms, the ten-parameter model, plus lens and reticle signatures; and a non-correctable random residual. After measurement on diffraction-based overlay targets, advanced process control feeds corrections to scanner actuators: the stage handles translation and rotation and the lens and reticle stage handle magnification, while corrections per exposure (CPE) give every field its own small set. More parameters absorb more systematic signature but also fit measurement noise, and the parameter count together with sampling density sets noise amplification.
units.model: 教學分解（3σ）：晶圓線性 2.5 nm、晶圓高階 1.8 nm、場內 1.5 nm、隨機 1.2 nm，總計 √13.18 = 3.63 nm。去除線性後 2.63 nm；CPE 吃掉高階與場內 80% 變異後為 √(0.2×1.8² + 0.2×1.5² + 1.2²) = 1.59 nm。雜訊代價：量測雜訊 0.3 nm、p = 300 參數、n = 600 點時加入約 0.3·√(p/n) = 0.21 nm。~Teaching decomposition (3σ): wafer linear 2.5 nm, wafer higher-order 1.8 nm, intra-field 1.5 nm and random 1.2 nm, total √13.18 = 3.63 nm. Removing the linear part leaves 2.63 nm; CPE capturing 80% of higher-order and intra-field variance leaves √(0.2×1.8² + 0.2×1.5² + 1.2²) = 1.59 nm. Noise cost: with 0.3 nm measurement noise, p = 300 parameters and n = 600 points, about 0.3·√(p/n) = 0.21 nm is added.
units.verify: 在監控晶圓上做高密度套刻取樣，以保留點交叉驗證選擇模型階數，確認殘差接近量測雜訊而非更低；把修正量套用到下一批後再量，比較預測與實際；並定期量測多台掃描機之間的匹配套刻，確認修正在機台間可轉移。~Sample overlay densely on monitor wafers and choose model order by cross-validation on held-out points, confirming that residuals approach measurement noise rather than fall below it; apply the corrections to the next lot, re-measure and compare prediction with result; measure matched-machine overlay between scanners periodically to confirm that corrections transfer across tools.
units.failure: 以稀疏而吵雜的資料擬合 CPE，等於把雜訊寫回機台；製程路徑改變（例如換了蝕刻腔）後仍用舊修正，套刻反而變差；修正量超出致動器範圍被截斷；套刻標記與元件圖案的偏差未校正，量測合格但元件不合格。~Fitting CPE to sparse, noisy data writes noise back into the tool; keeping old corrections after the process route changes, such as a different etch chamber, makes overlay worse; corrections beyond actuator range are clipped; an uncalibrated target-to-device offset lets metrology pass while devices fail.
units.misconception: 模型參數越多，套刻殘差一定越小。~More model parameters always give smaller overlay residuals.

units.anchor: 產能、可用度與交接~Throughput, availability and handoff
units.title: 每小時晶圓數與可用度的系統驗收~System acceptance of wafers per hour and availability
units.mechanism: 產能是在指定劑量與佈局下每小時能曝多少片晶圓。單片時間由三部分組成：曝光時間（晶圓端功率除以劑量決定）、每場的額外時間（加速、減速、穩定與步進）、以及雙載台無法隱藏的晶圓交換時間。產出量等於每小時晶圓數乘可用度與使用率；可用度受計畫保養（集光鏡、錫滴產生器更換）與非計畫停機（平均故障間隔與修復時間）限制。驗收時以指定劑量與佈局連續運轉，記錄每小時晶圓數、劑量穩定度、套刻、焦距與可用度，交接時附上光源功率趨勢、集光鏡反射率與護膜狀態。~Throughput is how many wafers per hour the tool exposes at a specified dose and layout. Wafer time has three parts: exposure time, set by wafer-level power divided by dose; per-field overhead for acceleration, deceleration, settling and stepping; and wafer exchange that the dual stage cannot hide. Output equals wafers per hour times availability and utilisation, and availability is limited by planned maintenance such as collector and droplet-generator swaps and by unplanned downtime governed by mean time between failures and mean time to repair. Acceptance runs the specified dose and layout continuously, logging wafers per hour, dose stability, overlay, focus and availability, and the handoff carries source-power trends, collector reflectance and pellicle status.
units.model: NXE 類教學：中間焦點 250 W、光學 1.5%、護膜 0.81，晶圓端 3.04 W；掃描速度 v = P/(D·W) = 3.04/(300 J/m² × 0.026 m) ≈ 0.39 m/s；96 場 × 858 mm² = 824 cm²，30 mJ/cm² 需 24.7 J、曝光 8.13 s；每場額外 60 ms 共 5.76 s；晶圓額外 2.0 s；合計 15.9 s，約 226 片/小時。可用度：每週計畫保養 6 h（3.6%）、MTBF 150 h 且 MTTR 5 h（3.2%），A = 93.2%，每天 226 × 24 × 0.932 ≈ 5055 片。~NXE-like teaching case: 250 W at intermediate focus, 1.5% optics and 0.81 pellicle give 3.04 W at the wafer; scan speed v = P/(D·W) = 3.04/(300 J/m² × 0.026 m) ≈ 0.39 m/s; 96 fields × 858 mm² = 824 cm² needs 24.7 J at 30 mJ/cm², 8.13 s of exposure; 60 ms overhead per field adds 5.76 s and wafer overhead 2.0 s, totalling 15.9 s or about 226 wafers per hour. Availability: 6 h weekly planned maintenance (3.6%) plus MTBF 150 h with MTTR 5 h (3.2%) gives A = 93.2%, or 226 × 24 × 0.932 ≈ 5055 wafers per day.
units.verify: 以指定劑量與佈局連續運轉至少 24 小時，從機台紀錄拆解每片晶圓的曝光、每場額外與晶圓交換時間，與模型逐項比較；依 SEMI E10 的設備狀態定義，以數週的事件紀錄計算可用度、MTBF 與 MTTR；同時統計每場劑量穩定度，確認產能不是以犧牲劑量控制換來的。~Run the specified dose and layout continuously for at least 24 hours, break each wafer's time into exposure, per-field overhead and exchange from machine logs and compare item by item with the model; compute availability, MTBF and MTTR from weeks of event logs using SEMI E10 equipment-state definitions; tally per-field dose stability at the same time to confirm that throughput was not bought by loosening dose control.
units.failure: 規格產能是在參考佈局與劑量下量得，客戶佈局若有更多部分場或更高劑量，實際產能明顯較低；可用度宣稱若未計入排定的集光鏡更換，產線排程會在保養週失準；短時間的最佳紀錄被誤當成長期持續產能。~Specified throughput is measured at a reference layout and dose, so customer layouts with more partial fields or higher dose run noticeably slower; availability claims that leave out scheduled collector swaps derail fab scheduling in maintenance weeks; a short best-case run is mistaken for sustained long-term throughput.
units.misconception: 光源功率加倍，每小時晶圓數就一定加倍。~Doubling source power always doubles wafers per hour.

example: High-NA 產能練習：劑量 50 mJ/cm²，300 mm 晶圓含部分場共 186 個半場，面積 186 × 429 mm² = 798 cm²，需能量 39.9 J；假設晶圓端功率 4.0 W，曝光時間 10.0 s。掃描速度 v = 4.0/(500 J/m² × 0.026 m) ≈ 0.31 m/s，光罩速度 8 × 0.31 ≈ 2.46 m/s。光罩台 32 g 時加速 2.46/313.8 ≈ 7.8 ms，每場額外時間取加速加減速再加 20 ms 穩定與步進，共 35.7 ms，186 場為 6.64 s；晶圓額外 2.0 s，合計 18.6 s，約 193 片/小時。若光罩台只有 8 g，加速 31.4 ms，每場 82.8 ms，186 場為 15.4 s，合計 27.4 s，只剩約 131 片/小時，說明半場加倍後高加速度載台對產能的關鍵性。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。~High-NA throughput exercise: at 50 mJ/cm² a 300 mm wafer holds 186 half fields including partials, 186 × 429 mm² = 798 cm², needing 39.9 J; assuming 4.0 W at the wafer the exposure time is 10.0 s. Scan speed v = 4.0/(500 J/m² × 0.026 m) ≈ 0.31 m/s and the reticle runs 8 × 0.31 ≈ 2.46 m/s. With a 32 g reticle stage the ramp takes 2.46/313.8 ≈ 7.8 ms; taking per-field overhead as acceleration plus deceleration plus 20 ms for settling and stepping gives 35.7 ms, or 6.64 s for 186 fields; adding 2.0 s of wafer overhead totals 18.6 s, about 193 wafers per hour. With only 8 g the ramp is 31.4 ms, each field costs 82.8 ms, 186 fields take 15.4 s, the total is 27.4 s and throughput falls to about 131 wafers per hour, showing why high-acceleration stages are essential once fields are halved. Values are teaching assumptions, not any tool's specification.
history: ASML 於 1984 年由 Philips 與 ASM International 合資成立，2000 年代以雙載台 TWINSCAN 與浸潤式 ArF 主導 DUV 市場，2010 年起出貨 EUV 試產機，2019 年 NXE 機型進入大量生產，光學由 ZEISS SMT 供應。0.55 NA 的 EXE 平台首批模組於 2023 年 12 月交付客戶，採用 4×/8× 變形光學與半場曝光。本延伸單元只重建公開物理與系統工程邏輯，不涉及專有配方或機台參數。~ASML was founded in 1984 as a Philips and ASM International joint venture, led the DUV market in the 2000s with the dual-stage TWINSCAN and ArF immersion, shipped EUV pre-production tools from 2010 and saw NXE systems enter volume manufacturing in 2019, with optics supplied by ZEISS SMT. The first modules of the 0.55 NA EXE platform reached a customer in December 2023, using 4×/8× anamorphic optics and half-field exposure. These extension units reconstruct only public physics and systems-engineering logic, not proprietary recipes or tool parameters.
